title: -re verbs in the present, not anymore
summary: -re verbs, singular: drop -re and the consonant before it in sound: perdre → je perds, tu perds, il perd. vendre → je vends, il vend. attendre → j'attends, il attend. In the plural, -re verbs act like -er verbs: ils perdent, ils vendent, ils attendent (now you hear the d). ne … plus = not anymore: Elle n'attend plus.
points: -re verbs: je / tu add a silent s, il / elle add nothing: je perds, tu perds, il perd. All sound like 'per'.
-er verbs only lose -er in sound. -re verbs lose -re and the consonant before it.
they: ils perdent, ils vendent, ils attendent. The -ent makes the d audible.
tout le temps = all the time. encore = again.
ne … plus = not anymore / no longer: Elle n'attend plus.
drills: You lose them all the time.
Tu les perds tout le temps.
They (fem.) aren't waiting for you any longer.
